Custom Case-sensitive String Compare

Problem Statement:
Given two strings S1 and S2, check whether they are case-sensitively equal without using any predefined string functions (like .equals(), .compareTo(), etc.). If they are the same, print 'yes', otherwise print 'no'. 
Input Description:
A single line with two space-separated strings S1 and S2. 
Output Description:
Print 'yes' if both strings are equal (case-sensitive). Otherwise, print 'no' 
Sample Input:
guvi guvi 
Sample Output:
yes
